{{Quote|Luunim owed everyone money. It was bound to get him into trouble one day.|A bartender|<ref name="Target" />}}
'''Mak Luunim''' was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] who resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. Aside from being a collector of art based on himself, Luunim also supported the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] by [[Accountant/Legends|handling]] its secret financial accounts. After [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], the Alliance lost a significant amount of its funds and needed the secret accounts tended by Luunim.

Luunim was tasked with meeting Rebels [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] at his [[Mak Luunim's apartment|home]] to hand over a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] that held the account access codes, but Luunim [[Death/Legends|died]] in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] accident before he could make contact with them. The Rebels later discovered that Luunim's death was orchestrated by [[Nal Kenuun]], a feared [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] to whom Luunim owed [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

==Biography==
===Joining the Rebel Alliance===
{{Quote|Our contact on the planet, Mak Luunim, is holding a datacard containing the access codes. Once you've retrieved them, he's agreed to help you transfer the accounts offworld and get you safely off the planet.|General Jan Dodonna|<ref name="Target" />}}
[[File:Jan_Dodonna.jpg|thumb|right|250px|General Jan Dodonna arranged the meeting with Mak Luunim.]]
Mak Luunim was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] who resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. He was an avid collector of [[Marble/Legends|marble]] sculptures and paintings that depicted his likeness, commissioning Muunilinst's greatest [[Artist/Legends|artisans]] to make them and thus entangling himself in heavy debt to many individuals. Despite his monetary problems, Luunim [[Accountant/Legends|handled]] several financial accounts for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Target" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NERC" /> shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] arranged for Luunim to meet with fellow Rebels [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] at the Muun's [[Mak Luunim's apartment|apartment]] in Pilaan to hand over a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] that Luunim was keeping safe. The datacard contained several account access codes that the Alliance desperately needed, as the majority of its funds had been lost when [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Organa's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the Death Star.<ref name="Target" />

However, before Luunim could meet with the Rebels, he [[Death/Legends|died]] in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] accident due to a failure in its central turbine while mid-air. Luunim's demise was actually orchestrated by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] under the employ of [[Nal Kenuun]], a ruthless [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] to whom Luunim owed [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. When Organa and Skywalker, accompanied by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who provided [[Transport/Legends|transportation]] to Muunilinst; and [[X-7|Tobin Elad]], an Imperial [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] working undercover among the Rebels, arrived at Luunim's apartment, they were greeted by his grieving [[Mak Luunim's employee|employee]].<ref name="Target" />

===Cause of death===
{{Quote|There are many ways to die, and as you knew Mak Luunim, you know what happens to beings who choose not to repay their debts to me.|Nal Kenuun to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Target" />}}
[[File:Muunilinst.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Muunilinst, Mak Luunim's homeworld]]
The employee informed the Rebels that Luunim had already passed away and before they could learn more of what happened, six Imperial stormtroopers appeared and attempted to capture the Rebels. A short [[Mission to Muunilinst|skirmish]] ensued between the two groups, with the Rebels taking down three of the stormtroopers and locking the rest within Luunim's apartment, which was outfitted with a state-of-the-art security system. The Rebels were able to escape unharmed and hid inside one of the city's many [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]].<ref name="Target" />

They later learned from a local [[Unidentified bartender (Muunilinst)|bartender]] that Luunim was in debt to a large number of individuals, and that almost everyone in the [[City/Legends|city]] did not believe his death was an accident. Further questioning of the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] revealed Luunim's debt to Kenuun. The Rebels deduced from the bartender's information that Kenuun had Luunim's apartment raided of anything valuable, including the datacard for which they were looking. Upon meeting Kenuun shortly after, the gambler confirmed their suspicion by admitting his involvement in Luunim's death.<ref name="Target" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|My Master. The great Mak Luunim. He commissioned work from Muunilinst's finest artisans, and naturally, they were all inspired to turn their talents to his noble form.|Mak Luunim's employee|<ref name="Target" />}}
Being a Muun, who were known for their financial skills, Luunim was assigned by the Alliance to safeguard a portion of its funds. Luunim was also an avid collector of art, commissioning many artisans to create works of art depicting his own image.<ref name="Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mak Luunim was created by author [[Alex Wheeler]] for the [[2008]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'', the first installment in the ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series.<ref name="Target" />
